generation.purpose: Continuous panoramic room coverage missing from source sheets and item sprites not usefully represented in source art.
generation.roomPromptTemplate: Photorealistic 360-degree equirectangular panorama of a lived-in African American family home during a house fire, one fixed camera; distinctive furnishings for each room, warm lamps and fire versus blue window light, visible doors, ceiling smoke, all depicted people African American, no people standing in the room.

roomDetails.living-room: Olive walls, fireplace, family photographs, terracotta sofa, records, windows.
roomDetails.dining-room: Terracotta walls, walnut family dining table, china cabinet, sideboard with family photos.
roomDetails.kitchen: Sage cabinets, island, stove, fridge with family photographs, dish towels.
roomDetails.den: Navy walls, leather sofa, reading chair, books and records, graduation photographs.
roomDetails.master-bedroom: Dusty blue walls, bed with ochre throw, wardrobe, wedding photographs.
roomDetails.toddler-bedroom: Sage nursery, low bed, quilt, toys, Black doll, family photographs.
roomDetails.game-room: Navy walls, green sofa, games, media cabinet, family photographs.
roomDetails.music-studio: Desk, laptop, studio monitors, microphones, synth, guitar, acoustic panels, podcast chairs.
roomDetails.hallway-front-entry: Front door at zero degrees, console with mail and family photographs, shoes, coat hooks.

generation.extraItemPrompt: 4x3 true-alpha photoreal inventory sheet: backpack, cash, house key, flashlight; headphones, MIDI keyboard, USB, audio interface; vinyl records, turntable, toolbox, map. No faces/logos. Cash replaced by a separate reverse-side banknote stack with no portraits.
